<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, onUnmounted, ref } from 'vue';

/** Lists the `data-dnd-*` attributes on the page right now: on `<html>`, the overlay, and the rows in `scope`. */
const props = defineProps<{ scope: HTMLElement | null }>();
const lines = ref<{ tag: string; attribute: string; note: string }[]>([]);

const describe = (element: Element, name: string) => {
  const value = element.getAttribute(name);
  return value ? `${name}="${value}"` : name;
};

const read = () => {
  const next: typeof lines.value = [];
  const html = document.documentElement;
  if (html.hasAttribute('data-dnd-dragging')) next.push({ tag: 'html', attribute: describe(html, 'data-dnd-dragging'), note: 'the page' });
  const overlay = document.querySelector('[data-dnd-overlay]');
  if (overlay) next.push({ tag: 'div', attribute: describe(overlay, 'data-dnd-overlay'), note: 'the overlay' });
  for (const name of ['data-dnd-placeholder', 'data-dnd-dragging']) {
    for (const row of props.scope?.querySelectorAll(`[${name}]`) ?? []) {
      next.push({ tag: 'li', attribute: name, note: row.querySelector('.title')?.textContent ?? '' });
    }
  }
  lines.value = next;
};

let observer: MutationObserver | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
  // Attributes change on the rows and on <html>; the overlay is added to <body>.
  observer = new MutationObserver(read);
  observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
    subtree: true,
    childList: true,
    attributes: true,
    attributeFilter: ['data-dnd-dragging', 'data-dnd-placeholder', 'data-dnd-overlay'],
  });
  read();
});
onUnmounted(() => observer?.disconnect());
</script>

    <ul>

        <span class="tag">{{ line.tag }}</span>
        <span class="attribute">{{ line.attribute }}</span>
        <span class="note">{{ line.note }}</span>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeDroppable, useDnD } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

const props = defineProps<{ tone: 'warm' | 'cool' | 'neutral' }>();
const colors = ref<string[]>([]);

const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
const { isOver, isAccepting } = makeDroppable(el, {
  accept: props.tone,
  onDrop: (e) => colors.value.push((e.active.data as { color: string }).color),
});

// Four looks: takes it, takes it and is under the pointer, refuses it, refuses it under the pointer.
const { active } = useDnD();
const state = computed(() => {
  if (!active.value) return '';
  if (isOver.value) return isAccepting.value ? 'over' : 'refused';
  return isAccepting.value ? 'accepting' : 'refusing';
});
const MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {
  accepting: 'Drop here',
  over: 'Release to add',
  refusing: `${props.tone} only`,
  refused: `Not a ${props.tone} colour`,
};
</script>

<template>
  <section ref="el" class="palette" :class="state">
    <h4>{{ tone }}</h4>
    <div class="colors">
      <span v-for="(color, index) in colors" :key="index" class="dot" :style="{ background: color }" />
    </div>
    <p class="message">{{ MESSAGES[state] ?? `${colors.length} colours` }}</p>
  </section>
</template>

const props = defineProps<{ slowSave: boolean }>();

const notes = ref([
  { id: 'n1', text: 'Call the venue about Friday', paper: '#fde68a' },
  { id: 'n2', text: 'Book the train', paper: '#fbcfe8' },
  { id: 'n3', text: 'Slides: cut to 10', paper: '#bbf7d0' },

  { id: 'n5', text: 'Renew the domain', paper: '#fde68a' },
  { id: 'n6', text: 'Water the plants', paper: '#bbf7d0' },
]);

const board = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('board');
const { items } = makeSortableList(board, {
  items: notes,
  strategy: 'grid',
  // An async `onBeforeDrop` keeps the overlay where it was let go, as `dropping`, until it resolves.
  onBeforeDrop: () => (props.slowSave ? new Promise<true>((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(true), 1000)) : true),
});
</script>

    <StickyNote v-for="note in items" :key="note.id" :note="note" :saving="slowSave" />
